description: This file declares functions for encrypting and decrypting data using TPM via the ESYS API, with specific focus on secure environment commands related to TPM encryption/decryption within the Android Open Source Project's Cuttlefish project.

methods.name: TpmEncrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data using TPM, with no integrity guarantees. Requires ESYS context, key handle, authentication, IV, input buffer, output buffer, and data size.

methods.name: TpmDecrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data using TPM, with no integrity guarantees. Requires ESYS context, key handle, authentication, IV, input buffer, output buffer, and data size.
